Core Four Roofing — Performance Report (private)

Upload this folder to your site, e.g.:
  https://corefourroofing.com/performance-report/

Password: CoreReport2026!

This package includes:
  - index.html     Performance report
  - ads.html       Residential ads game plan (Houston suburbs)
  - reviews.html   Review Shield (CMS → private rating → Google/Yelp)
  - robots.txt
  - assets/        Logos, favicon, hero image

Same password unlocks all three pages in that browser session.
Share the URL + password privately with the client. Search engines should not index it.
Note: This is a simple browser gate (not server-level security).
Serve over HTTPS — the password gate will not unlock on plain HTTP.
